sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Page head and app container
sections.what: Sets the browser tab title and icon and provides the empty container where the app appears. It also points to the main script that starts React.
sections.why: Likely reason: standard single-page app layout.
sections.watch_out: The title shown in the browser tab is set only here.

summary: The single web page that loads the React frontend and gives it an empty container to draw into.
purpose: Acts as the front door for the browser. It sets the page title and icon and links to the main script.
why: Standard layout for a Vite React app. The page itself has no content; React fills the root element.
how: The browser reads the head for the title and icon, then loads the script at src/main.tsx, which draws the app into the empty root element.
inputs: The icon file vite.svg and the script src/main.tsx.
outputs: A browser tab titled Financial Modeling Tool with the app shown inside it.
risks: If the script path is wrong, the page is blank. The icon file is not in the packet, so its presence is unverified.
debug: If the page is blank, open the browser developer console and look for script loading errors. Confirm the dev server is running on port 5173.
